sources.title: Magazine Cover Design
sources.limitations: A classroom brief and thumbnail-sketch exercise, not a production scoring system or a reusable cover template.

sources.title: Cover Story: What the Stack Awards Winner Tells Us About the New Rules of Magazine Design
sources.limitations: An editorial case discussion about changing cover contexts and social display, not a universal quantitative law.

sources.title: Graphic Design in Japan and public jury-comment context
sources.limitations: Award-selection context with public reviews. It does not justify reducing Japanese graphic design to whitespace, minimalism, or one house style.

sources.title: How Posters Work and digitized graphic-design collection context
sources.limitations: Museum exhibition framing supports composition, perception, and storytelling mechanics; it is not a single-style recipe and does not by itself establish every designer-specific claim about Hofmann, Crouwel, or Monguzzi.

sources.title: Editorial systems: The Baffler, The New Republic, Citizen, Stern, Sight and Sound, and London Fashion Week
sources.limitations: A family of public portfolio case studies. Their grids, type voices, crops, and image treatments are project-specific evidence, not layouts to copy.

sources.title: A guide to basic color theory and color contrast
sources.limitations: General color education. It does not prescribe a fixed palette, semantic color meaning, or a universal accent-area percentage.

sources.title: Interaction of Color
sources.limitations: Publisher material supports contextual and relative color perception. It does not replace the book, authorize long excerpts, or imply fixed color recipes.

sources.title: Karel Martens
sources.limitations: A public profile and interview example, not an exhaustive specification for Fantastic Man, The Gentlewoman, or all editorial design.

sources.title: Veronica Ditting
sources.limitations: A public editorial profile used only as contextual evidence; it does not expose a complete production system or license imitation.

sources.title: Schule für Gestaltung Bern collection note and Armin Hofmann acquisition context
sources.limitations: The object note provides collection and Swiss-poster context and names Armin Hofmann; it is not itself a Hofmann object record or a license to treat Swiss design as one style.

sources.title: Wim Crouwel a graphic odyssey collection tag context
sources.limitations: A collection index exposing a Wim Crouwel-related poster, not a comprehensive account of Crouwel's practice or a reusable grid.

sources.title: Museo d'Arte e Archittectura poster collection context
sources.limitations: A collection tag page identifying a poster gifted by Bruno Monguzzi; it supports object provenance but not a complete design method.

sources.title: The New Republic
sources.limitations: A project-specific portfolio case; its display voices and identity system are evidence of principles, not a template.

sources.title: Stern
sources.limitations: A project-specific portfolio case supporting flexible grids, scale, and pacing; no single layout is generalized.

sources.title: Citizen
sources.limitations: A project-specific portfolio case; typography weight and photographic breathing are interpreted as heuristics, not copied.

sources.title: Sight and Sound
sources.limitations: A project-specific portfolio case; visible grids, pace, and juxtaposition are evidence, not universal styling instructions.

sources.title: London Fashion Week SS19
sources.limitations: A fashion-specific identity case. Image-type collision is extracted as a relation principle, not a prescribed aesthetic.
